Remove the ruler completely. Compose the full scarf on the left, slightly smaller as needed, and place ONE compact pine-green pair of binoculars on the cream tabletop on the right. Binoculars are shown from an overhead three-quarter view, with two clearly connected parallel round barrels, two visible round objective rims, and a central bridge. They point away from the scarf. Their outline is visually clear and big enough to recognize at 96 pixels. Binoculars do not touch or cover the scarf and no magnified area appears. Same matte gouache paper grain, warm cream and pine green, clean cut-paper classroom style. No ruler, magnifying glass, hands, other props, text, numbers, logos or watermark.
